manifest_row.title: TransAlta Announces Transformative $2 Billion Clean Energy Investment Plan and Dividend Policy

screening.main_topic: TransAlta’s clean-energy investment plan, including converting coal-fired units to natural gas and expanding renewable energy projects.
screening.climate_relevance: The announcement centers on changes to the company’s electricity-generation portfolio, including moving away from coal, investing in renewables, and reducing air emissions—issues directly relevant to climate mitigation and energy transition.
screening.reason: Although the release also emphasizes costs, financing, and shareholder returns, its main subject is an energy investment plan involving coal-to-gas conversions and renewable generation. The climate-change reference in the corporate background is incidental, but the plan itself is substantially relevant to climate discourse.
